name: ryu.browser-use
description: Preview of Browser Use's open-source local browser as a provider for Ryu's swappable browser.control layer, over its official MCP server (`browser-use --mcp`). Not usable as the Browser layer yet: Ryu starts a fresh browser-use process for every tool call, and browser-use keeps its browser inside that process, so a tab opened by one call is gone by the next. It is hidden from the store while that is the case. The browseruse.* tools stay callable directly, but only a task that finishes within one call, such as retry_with_browser_use_agent, works that way. Launched from the pinned browser-use 0.13.11 package with uvx, with anonymous telemetry and cloud sync off; needs uv on PATH.

browseruse.description: Browser Use MCP server, launched via `uvx browser-use@0.13.11 --mcp` with anonymous telemetry and cloud sync off. Tools include browser_navigate, browser_click, browser_type, browser_get_state, browser_extract_content, browser_get_html, browser_screenshot, browser_scroll, tab management, session management, and retry_with_browser_use_agent. Unavailable until uv is installed and the pinned package can be fetched.
